title: Easy Stairs
description: This mod replaces vanilla stairs crafting with cheaper one
body:
## 🪜 About

This quality of life mod takes GarrettTheCarrot idea of making stairs cheaper in minecraft becouse it just make more sense. You can see crafting down bellow in details.

## 🪜 Other Media

If you found a bug, or want to suggest your own idea you can chat with me about it on our [Discord]

You can support me or buy texture pack on the [Patreon]

Also check out my [PMC page](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/WindyBee/)
